name: capacity-100g-vol
description: Real 100 GB-class acceptance on Docker named volumes: 100,000,000,000 bytes across 373 files of about 268 MB
notes: Same limits as capacity-100g, but storage is a Docker named volume instead of a Windows bind.
Use this profile only when the Docker disk image has about 190 GiB of free space: two complete copies are required.
The named volume runs on the VM's ext4, which avoids the 9p bind bottleneck that limits staging to about 45 MiB/s.
Every file stays limited to 1280 MiB and must finish complete AV and integrity checks; no sampling.
Fixtures are synthetic valid single-tensor safetensors files, not the original model weights.
